title: Toyota Prospect Management System - App (iOS, Android)
excerpt: Platform untuk menampilkan produk otomotif secara digital dengan fokus pada pengalaman pengunjung.

paragraphs: NewTPM is a dedicated mobile application for the Toyota Astra Motor (TAM) dealer network, including Sales personnel, Supervisors (SPV), and Dealer staff. Serving as an internal communication and lead management tool, it provides direct access to customer inquiries—typically those expressing intent to purchase a Toyota vehicle

Platform & Availability
- Available on the Google Play Store, Appstore and Website, tailored for Business category users.

Core Features:
- Lead Access & Management
- Intended User Group
- Privacy-first Design
